global_issues.title: Trump escalates economic threats on Iran; oil hits 3-week high
global_issues.note: Confirmed. Trump/Bessent threatened a 'crushing economic operation'/'economic D-Day' against Iran on 2026-08-20; Brent rose ~2.4% to $93.78, WTI +2.7% to $86.64, a 5th straight day of gains and highest level since late July. 'Economic pressure without large-scale combat restart' framing matches reporting.

global_issues.title: Treasury buyback intervention fails to hold yields lower
global_issues.note: Confirmed exactly. Treasury doubled long-end buybacks to $4B/operation; 10Y/30Y fell on the announcement day then reversed the next day (30Y +5.7bp to 5.251%, 10Y +5.1bp to 4.704%), wiping out the relief rally as described.

global_issues.title: Nvidia develops new China-targeted inference chip amid export controls
global_issues.note: Confirmed. Nvidia is preparing a China-compliant inference chip (The Information, CNBC reporting) while the US reviews/closes loopholes (offshore access, RASA legislation) in existing export controls.

grok_report.summary: The three global issues (Iran/oil, Treasury buyback failure, Nvidia China chip) are all accurate and well-sourced. However, the briefing omits the day's biggest market-moving event — Walmart's post-earnings plunge that drove the Dow down over 700 points — and its 'green/87.7' bullish mood framing is questionable given the broad-based selloff across all three major indices. MU's closing price also has a minor factual discrepancy.
